working_on.task: Completed Tier 1 (DOM Explorer), Tier 2 (Position-Agnostic Title Parser), and Tier 3 (Safe Fallback) End-to-End Integration
working_on.notes: All 3 phases completed with 100% test pass rate across unit and full live BridgeServer e2e integration tests. Real DOM fixture (body2.txt) verified.

recent_changes.description: Completed Phase 03: Integrated 3-Tier detection cascade (Tier 1 Explorer DOM -> Tier 2 Title -> Tier 3 Safe Fallback) into detectWorkspaceName and verified live BridgeServer discovery and port isolation without 409 mismatch.

Completed Phase 02: Refactored parseWorkspaceFromTitleString in media/autoplan-dom-bridge.js to be position-agnostic, supporting Antigravity IDE [Workspace] - [App] - [File] layout, stripping active tabs (Auto-Plan Settings), and normalizing (Workspace) suffixes.
Completed Phase 01: Added extractWorkspaceFromExplorerDOM and getActiveEditorOrTabNames to media/autoplan-dom-bridge.js for direct DOM extraction from Explorer section headers.

errors_encountered.error: HTTP 409 (workspace-mismatch) returned during BridgeServer probe on port 48860 when window title was 'Auto-plan-Extension-main - Antigravity IDE - Auto-Plan Settings' or active file name.
errors_encountered.solution: Implemented 3-Tier detection cascade: Tier 1 directly reads aria-label='Explorer Section: <Workspace>' from DOM; Tier 2 filters out app names and active tab/file names position-agnostically; Tier 3 safely defaults to empty string without sending invalid workspace names.

decisions_made: Prioritize Tier 1 DOM Explorer extraction over title parsing for highest confidence
Make title parser position-agnostic to support both Antigravity IDE and standard VS Code window title patterns
Filter out active tabs and known system screens (like Auto-Plan Settings) from title parser candidates
